title: Briarwood Farm
specs: Located minutes from Virginia Beach oceanfront in a vibrant equestrian community
Main barn with 21 stalls, automatic waterers, heated wash stalls, and air-conditioned lounge
Main riding ring 125’ x 250’ with stonedust base and 36’ lunge pen with deep sand base
Lessons for boarders with their own horses or current lease students; no lesson horses for general public
Proof of negative Coggins test and up-to-date vaccinations required for mares prior to arrival
Mares follow Briarwood Farm worming schedule upon arrival

options.detail: Horses and ponies for sale or lease, including registered Hanoverian gelding and OTTB mare.

options.name: Breeding and Foaling

options.name: IEA Team
options.detail: Interscholastic Equestrian Association team for middle and high school riders, open to local riders.

blurb: Briarwood Farm offers quality boarding and lessons for riders of all levels, focusing on personalized care and horsemanship. They provide professional training for started horses and have a breeding program with full monitoring and care. The farm also supports an Interscholastic Equestrian Association (IEA) team for middle and high school riders.
extraNote: All veterinary bills for breeding must be guaranteed by mare owner; liability waivers required · Inherent risks of breeding and foaling accepted by mare owners
